slot_m1_layer0_ambient_carrier.original_target: A finite cochain window (C0,C1,C2,d0,d1) with d1 d0 = 0 has quotient Q1 = C1/im(d0). Phi1([x]) is the quotient seminorm (min over potentials of the weighted l1 norm of x - d0 h). Gamma2 is the l1 norm of d1 applied to a minimizer, and R_cl = Gamma2/Phi1. Missing or ill-typed window data gives a typed NoRule refusal. Gamma2 here is a norm; QM_020 uses 'Gamma' for a set of residual sectors.
slot_m1_layer0_ambient_carrier.source_scope_review: A complete triangle window is supplied, with defect parameter used as an actual nonflat refusal. Gamma2 is the absolute face value, not a set of sectors. When Phi1=0 the ratio is undefined: its zero wire placeholder is always paired with a false defined tag. Output layout: [0] refusal else quotient layout plus gamma;ratio_defined;ratio_or_placeholder
